source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Errata to the Valourstrike Lance [Bold Gallantry](vsdata:ability/imperial-knights.valourstrike-lance.bold-gallantry) Detachment rule: whenever an **IMPERIAL KNIGHTS** unit of yours Advances, the ranged weapons of every **IMPERIAL KNIGHTS** model in your army get **[[ASSAULT]](vsdata:weapon-ability/assault)** for the rest of the turn.

change.trigger: an IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit of yours Advances
change.recipients: ranged weapons of all your IMPERIAL KNIGHTS models
